description: Get Kubernetes resources with kubectl get, as JSON by default.

name.description: Name of the specific resource to get; when omitted, all resources of the type are listed.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resource to get; when omitted, the current-context default namespace is used.

output_format.description: Output format for kubectl get, such as json or yaml; defaults to json.

resource_type.description: Kubernetes resource type to get, such as pods, deployments, or services.

name: kubectl_get
